name: Simple (AA 55, length as command): any car (raw messages)
description: Simple box whose frames have no command byte: AA 55 LEN data CS from the box, 55 AA LEN data CS to it, CS = (LEN + data) - 1; the length tells the message (6: Audi's misc, keys and steering message). Read from Car Info's decoder SpAudiProtocol (its deframer, parsePacket). No acknowledgement. Any car: no decoding, raw messages. Also the description of this box type ("box": "simple-aa55-len").
